web-search.name: web-search
web-search.description: Search the web using SearXNG instance at https://see.hyrule.vip/. Returns search results with titles, URLs, and descriptions. Supports same query format as web_search but uses local SearXNG instead of Brave API.

vision.name: vision
vision.description: Analyze images using Gemini 2.0 Flash vision API. Returns a text description of the image content. Usage: vision.sh <image_path> [custom_prompt]
